source_slug: 2026-03-23 Reassessing the role of data protection authorities in Africa

fact: The law firm Z. Mayet and Associates states that the Data Protection Act (Act 5 of 2012) establishes a Data Protection Commission, but that the Commission and its Commissioner have not been appointed, so the regulator does not exist in practice; no event date is given, so this is as at the document's publication date of 2025-10-31.

The Data Protection Act 2011 mandates a Data Protection Commission, which the article by Letsatsi Lekhooa for Digital Rights Alliance Africa says had still not been established almost fifteen years later.
Lesotho's ICT ministry principal secretary said at a closing workshop session that establishing an independent Data Protection Authority must be prioritised.
